data.name: Vishu
data.long_meaning: Vishu is the name of the Hindu deity Vishnu in his form as the preserver and protector of the universe. The name Vishu is derived from the Sanskrit word vish, which means 'all-pervading'. Vishu is believed to bring prosperity and wealth to those who call upon him.

data.numerology_meaning: Vishu is a name with a strong vibration and a powerful energy. The number 3 in numerology represents creativity, self-expression, and growth. Those named Vishu are likely to be imaginative, artistic, and full of energy.
